label: MARRIAGE REPAIR

cover.headline: 4 starting points when *you both want better*
cover.sub: Where to begin when you’re ready.

points.heading: Agree on the goal
points.body: Saying out loud that you both want things to improve is a real start.
points.panel: “I want us to feel closer. Do you want that too?”

points.heading: Pick one thing to work on
points.body: Trying to fix everything at once usually leads to fixing nothing.
points.panel: “What’s one thing that would make the biggest difference for you?”

points.heading: Set a regular check-in
points.body: A short weekly talk keeps progress from fading.
points.panel: Sunday evening, fifteen minutes: what went well, what to try next.

points.heading: Use a structure
points.body: When it’s hard to know where to start, a guided plan can help.
points.panel: Choose a resource you can both work through together.

resource.name: Save The Marriage System
resource.covers: A structured starting point for communication and reconnection.

caption:
When you both want things to get better but don’t know where to start, it’s easy to stay stuck in good intentions.

These four starting points turn wanting into doing. If you’d like a structured starting point for communication and reconnection, there’s a resource at the link in bio. It’s a place to begin, and no resource can promise how another person will respond.

Follow @spotseason for more small steps.
